defs.def: in a short time from now; a short time after sth else has happened 很快；马上；不久

ex.s: She memorized the poem sooner than others.
ex.t: 他可能还会帮你订一间就在餐车旁边的卧铺车厢。

ex.s: See you sooner.
ex.t: 再见

ex.s: We started to practise together and soon became friends.
ex.t: 我们开始一起练习，很快就成了朋友。

ex.s: When she first came to my school, she seemed lonely, but we soon became friends.
ex.t: 她第一次来我的学校时，她似乎很孤独，但我们很快就成了朋友。

ex.s: Very soon after this, homes with gardens began to be built.
ex.t: 之后不久，带花园的房子开始建造起来。

ex.s: "You'll soon find out." We could also say I turned around and saw a man with white hair.
ex.t: "你很快会发现的",我们也可以说我转过身来看到一个白发的男人。

ex.s: However, I soon found that by doing so, I might be losing something more important: the opportunity to share a small part of my cultural identity.
ex.t: 然而我很快发现，这样做我可能正在失去更重要的东西：分享自己文化身份一小部分的机会。

ex.s: They bear a lot of fruit soon.
ex.t: 它们很快就会结很多果实。

ex.s: As we soon come to learn from AI by Design AI is already super-smart and will become more capable, moving from the current generation of “narrow-AI” to Artificial General Intelligence.
ex.t: 正如我们很快就能从《设计人工智能》中了解到的那样，人工智能已经超级聪明，并且将变得更强大，从当前的“狭义人工智能”发展到通用人工智能。

ex.s: Meowing starts as soon as a baby cat is brought to life and uses it to get the mother's attention and be fed.
ex.t: 喵喵叫从小猫一出生就开始，它用这种方式引起猫妈妈的注意并得到喂养。

ex.s: Soon Eva began to breathe hard, with her heart pounding and legs shaking.
ex.t: 但我对独立的需求驱使我坚持推进我的研究计划。

ex.s: Soon children will have enough space for football games.
ex.t: 不久孩子们将有足够的空间踢足球比赛。

ex.s: To me, that was the biggest thing ever and I soon learned the whole poem by heart, well prepared for our first rehearsal.
ex.t: 对我来说，那是有史以来最了不起的事，我很快就背下了整首诗，为我们第一次排练做好了充分准备。

ex.s: Soon after that, around 192 lakes in northwestern Alaska are gone from sight.
ex.t: 不久之后，阿拉斯加西北部大约192个湖泊消失了。

ex.s: You’ll soon find that the more patience you practice, the more you start to apply it to other, more annoying situations.
ex.t: 你很快就会发现，你练习的耐心越多，你就越开始把它运用到其他更恼人的情境中。

ex.s: I stopped, and she soon took wing but did not immediately fly away.
ex.t: 我停了下来，她很快飞了起来，但没有马上飞走。

ex.s: Soon after dinner, I handed the essay to mum.
ex.t: 晚饭后不久，我把文章交给了妈妈。

ex.s: As soon as she graduated from high school she left home to live on Catalina Island off the Californian coast, away from her parents, where she enjoyed a life of sailing and off-road biking.
ex.t: 她一从高中毕业就离开家，住到加州海岸外的卡塔利娜岛上，远离父母，享受航海和越野骑行的人生。

ex.s: With help from Tesla, Westinghouse's firm developed a system using alternating current, which soon became the major forms of power delivery.
ex.t: 在特斯拉的帮助下，Westinghouse 的公司开发了一种使用交流电的系统，很快成为电力输送的主要形式。

ex.s: As he went on to share his concept with others, the idea soon took off in India and other countries before eventually reaching Europe, where it became popular in places like France, Belgium and the Netherlands.
ex.t: 当他与其他人分享他的概念时，这个想法很快在印度和其他国家流行起来，最终传到欧洲，在法国、比利时和荷兰等地受欢迎。

ex.s: I decided to commit to completing the applications, and soon I was a part of a growing global team of young people working to protect nature.
ex.t: 我决心完成申请，很快我就成为一个不断壮大的全球年轻人团队的一员，致力于保护自然。

ex.s: The  23  of the room was soon broken by a quiet voice from behind the curtain.
ex.t: 房间里的23 很快被帘子后面一个平静的声音打破。

ex.s: It's still a little too cold for them to go out into the open, but as soon as the weather warms up, I have no doubt that the little one will be out and about exploring and playing every day.”
ex.t: 天气对他们来说还是有点太冷，不能到开阔地去，但等天气一暖和，我毫不怀疑这个小家伙就会整天在外面探索和玩耍。”

ex.s: I soon made friends with the local skaters.
ex.t: 我很快和当地滑板手交上了朋友。

ex.s: But soon I caught a few of his glances.
ex.t: 但很快我捕捉到他几道目光。

ex.s: What can we learn about the author soon after he moved to London?
ex.t: 关于作者刚搬到伦敦后不久我们能了解到什么？

ex.s: This happened over and over, but we soon learned to identify different grasses like cockleburs, lamb’s-quarters, foxtails, and the king of weeds, the pretty purple thistle.
ex.t: 这一次又一次发生，但我们很快学会了辨别不同的草种，如公鸡，羊肉的四分之一，狐尾，以及野草之王，漂亮的紫色的 this。

ex.s: But soon enough, his 17    took a turn.
ex.t: 但很快，他的17___出现了转机。

ex.s: They had driven their son several hours out of town to the university where he would soon be living and studying.
ex.t: 他们开了几个小时的车把儿子送到城外的大学，他很快就将在那里生活和学习。

ex.s: I cannot make my decision immediately, but you will hear from me soon. ”
ex.t: 我不能立即做出决定，但你会很快收到我的回复。

ex.s: And, having spoken to many of the world's foremost AI researchers, I believe there is good reason to doubt that we will see A GI any time soon, if ever:
ex.t: 而且，在和世界上许多顶尖AI研究人员交谈后，我确信有充分理由怀疑我们近期——甚至根本——不会看到AGI出现：

ex.s: It will come into being soon.
ex.t: 它很快就会实现。

ex.s: It'll reach consumers soon.
ex.t: 它很快会面向消费者。

ex.s: They rose in the ranks not by being friendly but by smoking cigarettes, breaking rules and playing jokes on others, among whom I soon found myself.
ex.t: 他们在队伍中的崛起不是因为友好，而是因为抽烟、违反规则和取笑别人，我很快就发现自己就在别人中间。

ex.s: However, I soon   45   that much has changed since the days of disturbing reports of   46   among tons of rubbish.
ex.t: 然而，我很快就45了，自从有令人不安的报告说有46吨垃圾以来，情况发生了很大变化。

ex.s: 58   you climb into an arctic-like zone with   59   snow and the glaciers that may soon disappear.
ex.t: 58  你爬进一个像北极一样的区域，那里有____雪和可能很快消失的冰川。

ex.s: Soon she drove to meet Zac in Watertown, N.Y.
ex.t: 很快她就开车到纽约州沃特敦去见扎克。

ex.s: Cutting of Big Trees to Be Prohibited in California Soon
ex.t: 加州即将禁止砍伐大树

ex.s: Soon I will graduate and become part of the real world.
ex.t: 我很快就要毕业，成为现实世界的一部分。

ex.s: Soon you will also question whether the voice you're hearing is actually real.
ex.t: 机器人电话的问题已经变得如此严重，以至于许多人现在拒绝接听来自陌生号码的电话。

ex.s: Soon afterwards, many of those people started settling down to become farmers, and their languages too became more settled and fewer in number.
ex.t: 不久之后，那些人中的许多开始定居下来成为农民，他们的语言也随之变得更加稳定，数量也减少了。

ex.s: But soon, the gold that Dawson depended on had all been found.
ex.t: 但很快，道森所依赖的黄金全部被找到了。

ex.s: When I was a little girl， my family moved to a tiny town at the bottom of a big mountain． One day after school， while exploring the green woods of this magnificent mountain， I almost fell on a set of stairs． What could these steps lead to？ Curiosity got the best of me as I knew it would be starting to get dark soon． I started climbing up those strangely mysterious steps．
ex.t: 当我还是个小女孩时，我家搬到了一座大山脚下的一个小镇。有一天放学后，在探索这座壮丽山峰的翠绿树林时，我差点被一段台阶绊倒。这些台阶会通向哪里呢？好奇心占了上风，因为我知道天很快就要黑了。我开始攀登那些神秘莫测的台阶。

ex.s: I soon realized that the silence was not unpleasant.
ex.t: 我很快意识到这种安静并不令人不愉快。

ex.s: Soon Benjamin needed more fur.
ex.t: 不久本杰明就需要更多的毛。

ex.s: Benjamin would have real brushes soon.
ex.t: 本杰明很快就要离开家了。

ex.s: As soon as you get the answer you need, move on to the next person.
ex.t: 一旦得到你需要的答案，就转到下一个人身边。

ex.s: One of his friends had stopped to make a bicycle repair, but they had encouraged Mac to carry on, and they would catch up with him soon.
ex.t: 他的一个朋友停下来修自行车，但他们鼓励麦克继续前进，说很快就会赶上他。

ex.s: You wouldn’t think that a few    58   (month) of exercise in your teens would be enough    59    the rest of your life, and that’s also true for building your vocabulary—you have to keep at it daily, and pretty soon you will find that you have an excellent vocabulary.
ex.t: 你不会认为十几岁时几____58____（month 个月）的锻炼就足以____59____（受益）余生，建立词汇量也是如此——你必须每天坚持，很快你就会发现自己拥有出色的词汇量。

ex.s: Taylor will apply to college soon.
ex.t: 泰勒很快会申请上大学。

ex.s: But now it looks as if Arctic lakes are disappearing a century sooner than predicted.
ex.t: 但现在看来，北极湖泊消失的时间比预测的要早一个世纪。

ex.s: The main finding was that the dogs approached the experimenter significantly sooner in the unable scenario than in the unwilling scenario.
ex.t: 主要发现是，在"做不到"情境中，狗接近实验者的速度明显比在"不愿意"情境中快得多。

ex.s: And among people who don't exercise, the changes can start even sooner.
ex.t: 而在不运动的人身上，这些变化可能开始得更早。

ex.s: It will come to an end sooner or later.
ex.t: 它迟早会结束。

ex.s: By the end of the century，if not sooner，the world's oceans will be bluer and greener thanks to a warming climate，according to a new study.
ex.t: 到本世纪末，如果不是早一点，世界的海洋将会因为气候变暖而变得更加蓝绿，根据一项新的研究。

ex.s: 40     It must be true that sooner or later, everyone finds his or her way back to nature.
ex.t: 40     每个人迟早都会回归大自然，这一定是真的。

ex.s: Soon, however, they realized what they had undertaken.
ex.t: 她们搬进当地一家姓Harrison的人家，和他们一样几乎没有隐私，很少洗澡，早晨醒来时被子上有雪。

ex.s: But it was now getting real dark． If I kept going I might not be able to see my way back． My mum would be worried sick if I didn't come home soon． So I ran back home almost in the dark while trying not to get too scared．
ex.t: 但天这会儿真的黑了。如果我继续走，可能看不清回去的路。如果我不快点回家，妈妈会担心死的。所以我几乎是摸黑跑回家，努力不让自己太害怕。

ex.s: But if governments don’t want a data economy controlled by a few giants, they must act soon.
ex.t: 但如果政府不希望数据经济被少数巨头控制，就必须尽快行动。
